projects.title: Selected projects
projects.detail: Websites and web products I've built

projects.name: FEMMORA
projects.summary: A clothing storefront preview with product categories, shopping interactions and a video-led visual direction.
projects.approach: The goal was to make browsing feel direct and visual. I built a clear category structure, product presentation and a small-screen experience that keeps the clothes at the centre.

projects.name: Forever Peng Hair
projects.summary: A London hair business site with guided appointment booking, service options, availability and deposit payment.
projects.approach: The booking journey brings services, add-ons, date selection, pricing and the required deposit into one clear flow. I also worked on the customer confirmations and administrative experience.

projects.name: Gas Safety & Plumbing
projects.summary: A service website for a UK gas, heating and plumbing business, with clear routes to emergency help and enquiries.
projects.approach: I organised the business services, contact routes and emergency information so visitors can quickly understand the offer and get in touch.

projects.name: Power Electrode
projects.summary: A company website for a Ghanaian welding electrode manufacturer, covering products, manufacturing and enquiries.
projects.approach: The site gives customers a direct route from learning about the products and manufacturing process to contacting the team about their requirements.

projects.name: Lucenex Corp
projects.summary: A corporate website for a data analytics and AI company, with a clearer presentation of its services and contact paths.
projects.approach: I worked on responsive page layouts and interface improvements for the company's web presence while collaborating remotely with stakeholders.

projects.name: NUMO & SEBI
projects.summary: An editorial jewellery shopping concept presenting collections and product details with a restrained visual style.
projects.approach: I used a simple shopping structure and prominent product imagery to let the jewellery and its story carry the experience.
